title: Dodgermentary: 1988 Regular Season
description: The Dodgers' historic 1988 regular season, when Kirk Gibson made an immediate impact in spring training, the contentious games against the New York Mets, and Orel Hershiser broke the MLB record for consecutive scoreless innings pitched.

title: Dodgermentary: 1988 NLCS
description: Considered one of the best postseason series in MLB history, the 1988 NLCS supplied all the Hollywood drama fans could ask for. From Mike Scioscia's dramatic game-tying home run in Game 4 to Orel Hershiser pitching a complete game shutout in the series-deciding Game 7, the Dodgers would heroically clinch a berth in the World Series after defeating the New York Mets.

title: Dodgermentary: 1988 World Series
description: Chronicles the 1988 World Series, where the Dodgers faced the heavily favored Athletics. The Dodgers would upset Oakland and win their sixth world championship in franchise history.
